answer: Histories are stored in ferrous, checked in dawn, and dune reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 17 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2578 identities would post 4348 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
